db_engine.description: Database engine: sqlite, mysql, or postgresql

db_host.description: Database server hostname (used only for MySQL/PostgreSQL)

db_port.description: Database server port (MySQL default: 3306; PostgreSQL default: 5432)

db_sqlite_path.description: Path to SQLite database file (used only when db_engine=sqlite)

default_container.description: Default container ID for browse requests (0 = root)

import_excluded_extensions.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to ignore

import_hidden_files.description: Include hidden files (dotfiles) during media scans

import_mappings.description: Mapping of file extensions to MIME types (e.g., { 'mp3': 'audio/mpeg' })

import_max_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan recursively

logging_level.description: Log verbosity level (ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG, VERBOSE, TRACE)

metadata_load_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for metadata loading

metadata_use_exiftool.description: Enable ExifTool for enhanced metadata extraction

playlist_enabled.description: Enable playlist support in web UI and clients

playlist_max_items.description: Maximum items allowed per playlist (0 = unlimited)

server_control_address.description: IP address for control interface (empty = all interfaces)

server_enable_port_mapping.description: Enable automatic port forwarding via UPnP IGD/NAT-PMP

server_hardware.description: Hardware vendor string for UPnP compliance

server_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to bind to (e.g., eth0, br0)

server_model_name.description: Model name shown to UPnP clients

server_model_number.description: Model number shown to UPnP clients

server_name.description: Display name of the UPnP server on the network

server_software.description: Software vendor string for UPnP compliance

server_uuid.description: Unique device identifier (must be a valid UUID)

server_virtual_address.description: IP address for media streaming interface (empty = all interfaces)

server_virtual_port.description: TCP port for virtual directory (media streaming)

transcoding_profiles.description: List of transcoding profiles for on-the-fly format conversion

web_address.description: IP address for web UI (empty = all interfaces)
